// RED fixture for `residency-pin` — the STORAGE-relevant slice (P-ST-04 / P-020). The lint MUST
// reject this. A CALLER opens the real `myelin-storage` OLTP store WITHOUT pinning a `Region` and
// WITHOUT the named-floor waiver marker — the data-leaves-its-region bug class (ADR-11). Every
// caller-facing store open must pin its region (or carry the loud, reviewed `@residency-cell-pinned`
// floor waiver). A bare region-less open in application code is the bug this lint makes un-mergeable.
pub async fn open_tenant_store(config: OltpConfig, minter: Arc<dyn IdMinter>) -> ColocatedOltp {
    ColocatedOltp::open(config, minter).unwrap()
}
